name: property tax appeals

product.purpose: Prepare evidence packets and customer-reviewed postcard proofs from county public records and customer supplied notices and comparable sales.
product.first_county_choice: Cook County, Illinois; homeowner self-file assist for an individual taxpayer filing for themselves.
product.filing_policy: For Cook County, an individual homeowner reviews the evidence packet, chooses the review stage, signs, and files personally through the county portal. Glacier prepares evidence and instructions only; it does not represent anyone or file.
product.billing: Owner confirms a flat packet fee before any checkout is enabled; no contingency billing is enabled.

schedules.purpose: Refresh the public Cook County assessor parcel roll each day and keep source alerts visible.

secrets_needed: LOB_API_KEY (optional test key only; rendering local proofs needs no key)

your_steps.title: Confirm the Cook County homeowner self-file scope
your_steps.when: Once, before the first Cook County case
your_steps.detail: Confirm the product is limited to Cook County individual-homeowner self-file preparation: Glacier prepares a packet and filing guide; the homeowner reviews, signs, and files personally. The owner action is recorded in ventures/property-tax/OWNER-STEPS.md. No customer case is filed by Glacier.

launch_gates: Confirm the Cook County individual-homeowner self-file scope once before the first case.
For each case, the homeowner reviews the packet, resolves uncertainty, signs, and files personally; Glacier never files.
Paid checkout stays disabled until the owner confirms packet pricing; it is not required for local packet preparation.
Live mailing stays disabled; postcard flow renders local proofs only.
